item.name: Fenway Drive
item.unlocks: Adds this small starter house to the job site list.
item.cardSummary: One of the three small houses you can pick from the first job, with no level gate and no Instant Unlock cost.

item.name: Juniper Road
item.unlocks: Adds this small starter house to the job site list.
item.cardSummary: A compact starter house available from Level 0, often used for short, low-risk jobs.

item.name: Lincoln Street
item.unlocks: Adds this small starter house to the job site list.
item.cardSummary: The third starter house, open from Level 0, with a basement unlike the other small launch homes.

item.name: Starter Equipment
item.unlocks: Makes Blacklight, EMF Reader, Flashlight, Flower Pot, Laser Projector, Spirit Book, Spirit Box, Thermometer, and Video Camera available, with one of each free every job.
item.cardSummary: The nine starter tools are unlocked from the start. One of each is free every job; extra copies still cost cash.

item.name: Photo Camera
item.unlocks: Adds the Photo Camera to the equipment shop.
item.cardSummary: The first shop tool, used to take paid investigation photos once you reach Level 3 or skip the gate for R$160.

item.name: Lilim Lane
item.unlocks: Adds this medium two-floor house to the job site list.
item.cardSummary: The first medium job site, a two-floor house that opens at Level 4 or with a R$240 Instant Unlock.

item.name: Cross
item.unlocks: Adds the Cross to the equipment shop.
item.cardSummary: A Level 5 shop tool used to stop a hunt from starting near the ghost room.

item.name: Lighter
item.unlocks: Adds the Lighter to the equipment shop.
item.cardSummary: A cheap Level 5 tool for lighting lanterns, candles, and a Summoning Circle.

item.name: Bodega
item.unlocks: Adds this small two-floor shop to the job site list.
item.cardSummary: The first non-house small map, a two-floor corner store that unlocks at Level 6.

item.name: Lantern
item.unlocks: Adds the Lantern to the equipment shop.
item.cardSummary: A Level 7 light source that also slows energy drain for nearby hunters when it is lit.

item.name: Cafe
item.unlocks: Adds this medium two-floor cafe to the job site list.
item.cardSummary: A medium two-floor cafe that unlocks at Level 8.

item.name: Prison
item.unlocks: Adds this large prison to the job site list.
item.cardSummary: The first large job site, a prison that opens at Level 9.

item.name: Salt Canister
item.unlocks: Adds the Salt Canister to the equipment shop.
item.cardSummary: A Level 10 shop tool used to lay salt lines for footprint evidence.

item.name: Challenges tab
item.unlocks: Lets the party leader add Challenges from the Shop Job Site tab.
item.cardSummary: At Level 10 the party leader can attach daily job modifiers from the Shop. This unlocks the tab, not any one modifier.

item.name: Energy Drink
item.unlocks: Adds Energy Drinks to the equipment shop.
item.cardSummary: A Level 12 consumable that restores energy during a job.

item.name: The Hanged Man
item.unlocks: Adds The Hanged Man to the perks shop.
item.cardSummary: The first perk, a Level 12 card that lets Crosses burn twice for one job.

item.name: School
item.unlocks: Adds this large school to the job site list.
item.cardSummary: A large two-floor school that unlocks at Level 13.

item.name: Temperance
item.unlocks: Adds Temperance to the perks shop.
item.cardSummary: The cheapest perk, unlocking at Level 14 and adding extra photo discards for one job.

item.name: Head-Mounted Camera
item.unlocks: Adds the Head-Mounted Camera to the equipment shop.
item.cardSummary: A Level 15 camera teammates can watch from base camp without using an inventory slot.

item.name: The Empress
item.unlocks: Adds The Empress to the perks shop.
item.cardSummary: A Level 15 team perk that speeds up stamina regeneration for every hunter on the job.

item.name: Bridgewood Drive
item.unlocks: Adds this medium forest mansion to the job site list.
item.cardSummary: A larger medium mansion that unlocks at Level 16.

item.name: Beach House
item.unlocks: Adds this small one-floor beach house to the job site list.
item.cardSummary: A small single-floor beach house that unlocks at Level 17.

item.name: The Chariot
item.unlocks: Adds The Chariot to the perks shop.
item.cardSummary: A Level 18 team perk that raises walk speed for every hunter on the job.

item.name: Holy Oil
item.unlocks: Adds Holy Oil to the equipment shop.
item.cardSummary: A Level 19 shop tool that lays a hunt barrier the ghost cannot cross.

item.name: Asylum
item.unlocks: Adds this large asylum to the job site list.
item.cardSummary: The largest job site, unlocking at Level 20.

item.name: Energy Watch
item.unlocks: Adds the Energy Watch to the equipment shop.
item.cardSummary: A Level 20 shop tool for checking energy without going back to base camp.

item.name: Strength
item.unlocks: Adds Strength to the perks shop.
item.cardSummary: A Level 22 team perk that doubles stamina for every hunter on the job.

item.name: Sun
item.unlocks: Adds Sun to the perks shop.
item.cardSummary: A Level 24 perk that makes Holy Oil burn twice for one job.

item.name: Oakbridge Estates
item.unlocks: Adds this medium multi-unit estate to the job site list.
item.cardSummary: A sprawling medium estate that unlocks at Level 25.

item.name: LIDAR Scanner
item.unlocks: Adds the LIDAR Scanner to the equipment shop.
item.cardSummary: A Level 25 scanner that shows the ghost's outline so you can find it, not gather evidence.

item.name: Plushie
item.unlocks: Adds the Plushie to the equipment shop.
item.cardSummary: A Level 30 shop tool used to check or rule out Spirit Box evidence after a ghost interacts with it.

item.name: Defibrillator
item.unlocks: Adds the Defibrillator to the equipment shop.
item.cardSummary: A Level 35 revive tool that brings one dead hunter back once.

item.name: The Emperor
item.unlocks: Adds The Emperor to the perks shop.
item.cardSummary: A Level 35 team perk that gives every hunter an extra inventory slot for one job.

item.name: Rock Salt Shotgun
item.unlocks: Adds the Rock Salt Shotgun to the equipment shop.
item.cardSummary: The last documented unlock: a Level 40 shotgun that can end a hunt when fired at the ghost.
